Site.footerDescription: A digital museum experience for Chinese intangible cultural heritage, connecting moving images, stories, geography and living transmission.

hero.title: Huayun
hero.subtitle: Living Heritage
hero.description: Enter a restrained, immersive and internationally oriented digital museum of Chinese heritage through moving images, objects, voices and regional stories.

intro.title: Intangible heritage is living cultural memory.
intro.description: Chinese intangible cultural heritage lives in hands, voices, seasonal rituals, oral traditions and community life. It is not a static specimen, but a continuing practice of skill, aesthetics and emotional connection.

map.title: China Map Explorer
map.description: Explore heritage through provinces, returning stages, kilns, silk threads and festivals to the landscapes and local lives that shaped them.

assistant.title: AI Heritage Guide
assistant.description: Ask about heritage history, related projects, inheritors and regions through a site-grounded AI guide.

MapExplorer.hint: Select a province marker to view local heritage items
MapExplorer.mapLabel: China intangible cultural heritage map explorer

meta.description: Browse Huayun's Chinese intangible cultural heritage archive and explore the history, materials and techniques of tie-dye.

HeritageListPage.title: Heritage Archive
HeritageListPage.description: Search representative projects by category, region and keyword, moving from stage, handcraft, folk ritual and oral tradition into more specific cultural scenes.

HeritageDetail.storyTitle: Enter a living tradition through its scenes
HeritageDetail.storyDescription: Moving images, geography, craft details and human transmission bring an archive record back into a perceivable cultural scene.
HeritageDetail.timelineDescription: A few key moments show how a local practice enters public cultural memory.
HeritageDetail.inheritorIntro: Transmission is not static preservation; it continues through practice, narration and renewal.
HeritageDetail.relatedDescription: Continue exploring regional, technical and performative traditions that resonate with this cultural practice.
HeritageDetail.consultationAvailable: Consultation for commissions, exhibitions and brand collaborations

InheritorsPage.metaDescription: Browse Chinese intangible heritage inheritors, representative works, interview videos and associated heritage projects.
InheritorsPage.title: Inheritor Features
InheritorsPage.description: Enter heritage scenes through practice, narration and creation, and see how living traditions continue in the present.
InheritorsPage.empty: No inheritor data yet. Add inheritor profiles in the content admin.

InheritorDetail.heritageDescription: This inheritor's representative practice is closely connected to the associated heritage project, whose detail page includes history, imagery, timeline and related exhibits.
InheritorDetail.worksDescription: Use the associated heritage project as a representative work entry into technique, moving image and regional culture.
InheritorDetail.interviewDescription: Watch the inheritor's practice scenes, narration and technical details through video.
InheritorDetail.interviewEmpty: No interview video has been configured for this inheritor yet.

AdminPage.description: Manage heritage items, categories, images and video assets. Write operations require the Supabase service role and Admin Key.

NotFound.title: This exhibit was not found

MuseumPage.metaDescription: Enter Huayun's digital museum for Chinese intangible heritage, featuring curated topics, annual recommendations and curatorial stories.
MuseumPage.title: Digital Museum
MuseumPage.description: A curatorial entrance that reorganizes heritage films, objects, regions and human stories into a quiet, luminous contemporary museum experience.
MuseumPage.featuredDescription: Opera, craft, traditional techniques, folk rituals and oral literature are organized as expandable digital exhibition lines.
MuseumPage.annualDescription: Recently highlighted exhibits are arranged by inscription year and content depth, showing how living heritage enters public memory.
MuseumPage.storyDescription: Short editorial narratives connect images, historical fragments, local life and ongoing practice by inheritors.
MuseumPage.empty: No museum content is available yet. Add published heritage items in the content admin.

AssistantPage.metaDescription: Ask Huayun's AI heritage guide about Chinese intangible heritage, related projects, inheritors, history and regions.
AssistantPage.title: AI Heritage Guide
AssistantPage.description: A site-grounded assistant for exploring Chinese intangible cultural heritage through history, projects, inheritors and regional clues.
AssistantPage.panelDescription: The guide retrieves Huayun website content first, then uses OpenAI to compose a concise museum-style answer when configured.
